name: SA Corporate Real Estate Limited
source: UNITS: every figure in this file is in absolute ZAR; the newest column was read from a statement printed in R thousands and multiplied by 1,000. CRON 20261122: H1 2026 column from the issuer unaudited condensed consolidated interim statement of comprehensive income, six months ended 30 June 2026, unit R thousands stored here in absolute rand. The statement prints no cost of sales or gross profit line, so those cells are an honest dash. Operating expenses are the printed 819,983 including 9,049 expected credit losses and before the 118,843 fair value gain on investment property, so revenue less operating expenses is 686,740 and the fair value gain less expected credit losses brings it to the printed operating profit of 796,534, the normal shape for a REIT. Net finance costs are interest expense 368,317 less interest income 19,743. The printed profit before taxation 615,250 plus the taxation credit of 513 equals the printed profit after taxation 615,763, so income tax is stored negative. Below the operating line sit a 5,100 foreign exchange gain, a 136,009 fair value gain on swap derivatives, a 1,715 capital loss on disposal and 27,896 profit from investments in joint ventures and the associate. EPS is basic 22.51 cents converted to rand. || CRON 20261120_0440: bare alias and resolved statement unified from the same company's two copies. Period union taken; a blank rendered cell was filled from the alias only where the alias carried the value and its figures run at the same scale (unit guard).
